messages:
Marie: quick postmortem follow-up after yesterday's vendor auth + model-registry latency spike. I pulled the draft and we need owners on follow-ups before EOW. :clipboard:
Devon: saw error patterns where token refresh to vendor auth delayed ~2s and model registry list calls timed out, which cascaded into longer regen times. :thinking_face:
AJ: alerting caught the 5xx surge but not the auth-token retry storm. I'll expand alert thresholds and add a deduper on retries. Owner: AJ. ETA: Tue 09:00. :+1:
Devon: I'll own a short-term mitigation: snapshot the model-registry metadata locally every 10m so we can serve reads if vendor API is unavailable. Implementation plan: cron job -> s3 snapshot -> local cache invalidation. Owner: Devon. ETA: Wed EOD.
Lina: we should also get a clarified SLA addendum for auth latency (p50/p95) and a penalty clause for sustained outages. I'll reach out to vendor legal. Owner: Lina. ETA: Fri EOD.
Marie: new permanent fallback policy: if vendor auth > 1s p95 for 5m, route read-only registry to local snapshot and serve cached tokens for 30s while failing fast for writes. Add to runbook. Owner: Marie (runbook update), Devon (automation). ETA: Thu.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: production-deploy successful for cache-snapshot-job (sha: 7c2f3b) at 2180457001
Devon: sample config for snapshot job I pushed to repo, snippet:```yaml
cron: "*/10 * * * *"
job: snapshot_registry
targets: [models, metadata]
retention: 72h
```
AJ: also proposing a small rate-limit envelope on token-refresh to avoid retry storms. Will add small token-backoff and circuit-breaker. Owner: AJ. ETA: Wed.
Marie: tracking dashboard items: p50/p95 auth latency, registry list-time, retry storm count, fallback activation count. I'll create dashboard and share. Owner: Marie. ETA: Mon.
vendor-eng: thx for the detailed notes — we'll surface our internal auth tracing to help debug latency hotspots. Can you share the timeline?
Marie: sending incident timeline to vendor now and attaching request for traces. Also pinging account manager for a post-incident review.
Devon: one recurring pattern I noticed across the last 3 vendor incidents: registry list + token refresh tend to coincide under high write load. We should run a chaos test simulating token delays + high write QPS. Owner: Devon. ETA: next sprint.
Lina: also recommend escrowed model snapshots for critical customers (legal + ops to coordinate). Owner: Lina. ETA: next week.
Marie: action list summary (I'll add to postmortem doc):
- AJ: retry deduper + token backoff + circuit-breaker (ETA Wed)
- Devon: 10m registry snapshot automation + chaos test plan (ETA snapshot Wed EOD, chaos next sprint)
- Marie: runbook + dashboard + vendor timeline request (ETA runbook Thu, dashboard Mon)
- Lina: SLA addendum + escrow coordination (ETA Fri & next week)
- Vendor-eng: provide auth traces & join post-incident review (TBD)
Please react with :eyes: if you accept the owner or :raised_hand: if you need to swap. We'll do a 15m sync after owners ack to lock dates.
AJ: :eyes:
Devon: :eyes: swapping chaos test to pair with SRE next sprint — fine with owners list.
Lina: :raised_hand: need a 2d slip on SLA draft due to vendor calendar clash, new ETA Mon next week.
Marie: noted. Updating the tracker. I'll schedule the 15m sync at 11:00 tomorrow and post invite. Closing note: please add any missing test cases to the postmortem doc — we want to turn this into a recurring regression check in our Optimize pipeline. :rocket:
